_meta.description: Expected simulated-clock replay of Wed Oct 21 - Thu Oct 22 for the showcase. 'without_heads_up' is what the persona screenshots show; 'with_heads_up' is what the agent should do. Use it to drive the Streamlit clock and to assert the decision log in pytest.

without_heads_up.detail: Gloria's first phone pickup of the day
Michelle's change arrives; Gloria doesn't see it
Early dismissal; nobody is at Oakwood Elementary
Original 'Pick up Ava' time. Alert: None
'Did you not see my text last night?'

after.summary: Pick up Ava — CHANGED by Michelle, was 3:15

with_heads_up.detail: Event is more than 2 h away, so the email waits for the morning briefing

with_heads_up.subject: Today: pick up Ava at 2:30, not 3:15
with_heads_up.body_large_print:
Good morning Gloria.

Michelle sent a change last night:

PICK UP AVA AT 2:30 TODAY (not 3:15)
Oakwood Elementary. Early dismissal.

Your calendar is updated, and your phone will remind you at 2:00.

Please tap the button so Michelle knows you got it.

with_heads_up.subject: Mom hasn't confirmed the 2:30 pickup yet — please call her
with_heads_up.body: Hi Michelle. Your change (pick up Ava at 2:30 today instead of 3:15) is on your mom's calendar with a 2:00 alert, but she hasn't tapped 'Got it' yet. Please give her a call to make sure she knows.
with_heads_up.shares_only: whether this one change was confirmed

with_heads_up.detail: Lock-screen alert: 'Pick up Ava — CHANGED by Michelle, was 3:15' at 2:30

alt_branch_confirmed._note: Same as with_heads_up until 08:00; Gloria taps 'Got it' at 9:15, so no escalation email goes out.

events.body: Your mom confirmed the 2:30 pickup for Ava today.
